limitations: Prepared exact-source only; application compilation and installed host acceptance remain independent gates.

One shared owner covers Settings staging operation; physical transfer internals, path authority and other Redux/profile writers remain separate gates. Failed partial destinations are never automatically deleted; error finalization does not clear pending transaction markers.
Captured path tuple and observed Redux context checks are not a global context lock; mid-transfer drift cannot undo work already started.
No native installation, registration, custody release or durable crash recovery permit.
